Package org.apache.juneau.commons.beanquery

Class BeanQuery.GroupBuilder

java.lang.Object
org.apache.juneau.commons.beanquery.BeanQuery.GroupBuilder
Enclosing class:
BeanQuery
public static final class BeanQuery.GroupBuilder extends Object
A group of cross-column conditions built with BeanQuery.Builder.or(Consumer), BeanQuery.Builder.and(Consumer), or BeanQuery.Builder.not(Consumer).

Exposes the same condition methods as BeanQuery.Builder, minus paging/view/sort/opts, since a group only ever contributes conditions to its enclosing level.

Example:

BeanQuery.create().or(g -> g.eq("a", 1).eq("b", 2)); // -> "$or(a=$eq(\"1\"),b=$eq(\"2\"))"

Since:
10.0.0
